args.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section (step 5), change `npm run serve` to `npm start`, matching the actual script defined in package.json's scripts block.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
package.json's scripts object only defines start, build, test, and lint (no serve), while README.md line 52 instructs users to run `npm run serve` after `npm run build`.
